title: LFRAG: Layout-oriented Fine-grained Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Multimodal Document Understanding
authors: Yifan Zhu; Yu Mi; Yue Lu; Yanchu Guan; Zhixuan Chu
why_relevant: Proposes fine-grained block-level multimodal RAG to reduce irrelevant context, tangentially related to noisy retrieval/distraction but focused on retrieval granularity rather than robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Does not directly study robustness, noise injection, conflict, attacks, or calibration; primarily an efficiency/accuracy method for multimodal document RAG.
